purpose: Test whether a pre-action policy can choose among already materialized Earth caches, cheap adaptation, and re-embedding under an explicit resource budget on held-out geospatial tasks or deployment episodes.

claim_boundary.primary: cost-aware action selection under Earth observation cache, contract, model-family, and shift constraints
not_claimed: a universally best Earth foundation model
direct comparability to the GEO-Bench-2 leaderboard without its full official protocol
independence of folds drawn from one task
Korean public-data accuracy improvement before sealed external evaluation
claim_boundary.separate_existing_policy: config/safe_cache_action_prereg_draft_v0.json remains the within-task support-set A0/A1 safety policy. This file is the cross-task and cross-family benchmark contract; the two policies must not be pooled as one experiment.

research_question: Before paying for every candidate pipeline, can target-side contract metadata, unlabeled cache sketches, measured costs, and optionally a small support set select the action with low held-out utility regret?

necessary_condition_gate_G0.unit: task_or_deployment_episode x model_family x action x fixed_budget
requirements: At least two independent task or deployment groups exhibit a best-action rank reversal beyond seed uncertainty, or measured cost budgets create a genuine Pareto crossover.
Oracle routing improves task-normalized score by at least 0.02 over the best static action in at least one predeclared budget track.
The oracle advantage is not created only by making an action unavailable after seeing its outcome.
necessary_condition_gate_G0.failure_action: Do not train a learned selector. Publish or retain the result as EarthCacheBench characterization and cache-value boundary evidence.

episode.definition: A dataset task or a prespecified geographic/temporal deployment group with one input contract, one label budget, and one resource budget.
not_independent_units: tiles from the same event or region
scale and readout variants of one model family

core6_candidate.local_state: download incomplete as of design freeze

core6_candidate.role: classification; choose exactly one before freeze

data_plan.korea_external_track: Held-out deployment case for public-data evidence and abstention. It does not replace the public benchmark and is not opened until its eligibility and leakage gates pass.

protocol_freeze_required_before_outcomes: band order, missing-band policy, GSD, temporal selection and cloud policy

actions.CACHED_HEAD: Read a precomputed frozen representation and train the standardized task head under the declared label budget.
actions.HEAD_ADAPT: Keep the representation cache fixed and adapt only the task head on the declared support set.
actions.REEMBED: Read raw imagery, execute the declared encoder release, materialize a new cache, and train the same task head.
actions.PEFT_REEMBED: Adapt the declared encoder with a fixed parameter-efficient recipe, re-embed, and train the same task head; ceiling arm, not novelty.
actions.REQUEST_MORE_LABELS: Fail closed when predicted action differences are within uncertainty or the input contract is unsupported.
actions.RAW_FINETUNE: Train a raw task model from scratch or source-init WITHOUT the cached encoder representation. Distinct from REEMBED (which runs the encoder). Baseline for 'is the cache worth anything', not a routing action. MS-97/99 A4w is this, not REEMBED.

availability_rule: An unsupported sensor or modality makes an action ineligible by a rule frozen before outcomes. It must not be encoded as a zero score or removed after observing performance.

tracks.Z0: No target labels for routing; labels may be used only to train the standardized downstream head if that is part of every compared action, never to choose the representation action.
tracks.K5: Five support units available to all eligible routing baselines.
tracks.K20: Twenty support units available to all eligible routing baselines.
tracks.BUDGET: Fixed measured GPU-time, raw-I/O, and cache-storage envelopes; report separate envelopes instead of tuning one arbitrary cost weight on test tasks.

allowed_pre_action: declared sensor, bands, GSD, temporal span, cloud rate and missingness
model family, release, parameter count, token support, cache dtype and bytes
unlabeled target cache mean, covariance, effective-rank and source-target distances
measured warm-read, cold-encode, raw-I/O and storage cost
support-only LogME, Task2Vec or loss/gradient features in K5 and K20 tracks
forbidden: metrics from an unavailable action at routing time
selector_inputs.prediction_target: pairwise action gain or task-normalized action regret, never absolute IoU, AP, accuracy or RMSE pooled across tasks

evaluation.confidence_intervals: hierarchical or cluster bootstrap over task, family, and geographic/temporal group; rows and folds are not i.i.d.
evaluation.primary: oracle-normalized action regret within each episode and budget
evaluation.benchmark_score: GEO-Bench-style task-normalized interquartile mean at each fixed budget
safety: harmful-action rate: selected action loses at least 0.01 normalized utility to the best safe static action

baselines: always best static cache selected on development tasks
unlabeled target-risk estimates such as ATC or GdScore when applicable
oracle action using held-out outcomes for evaluation only

promotion_gates.G1_regret: At least 30% lower mean normalized regret than the best static policy, with a task/family-grouped confidence interval excluding zero improvement.
promotion_gates.G2_score: At least 0.02 higher task-normalized IQM than the best static policy in one predeclared resource budget and no material loss in the others.
promotion_gates.G3_cost: At matched score within 0.01, at least 25% lower measured encoder plus raw-I/O cost than always re-embed.
promotion_gates.G4_external: Same direction on at least one fully held-out public task; Korea is an additional external case, not the only test.
promotion_gates.G5_reproducibility: At least three seeds for promoted cells and all report, cache, split, source, and environment hashes sealed.

cvpr_decision.main_candidate: G0 passes and G1 plus G2 plus either G3 or a strong external stress result pass.
cvpr_decision.characterization_fallback: G0 fails or routing does not beat the best static policy; retain the two-task cache-value result, release continuity failure, scale/family boundary, and measured cost curves.
cvpr_decision.stop: Do not add a VLM, MoE, federated learning, or Korean API fusion to rescue a failed selector.

normalization_rule.requirement: Fixed per-episode anchors declared before outcomes (lower_anchor, upper_anchor).
normalization_rule.forbidden: min-max normalization over the eligible/evaluated actions (violates IIA under budget filtering).
normalization_rule.lower_anchor: fixed supervised baseline or fixed reference floor
normalization_rule.upper_anchor: full-label strong baseline or fixed reference ceiling
normalization_rule.also_report: native-metric per-episode regret and IIA invariance check (code/geobench_action_headroom.check_iia)

cost_schema_additions.support_label_count: labels the action consumed; adaptation's key cost, added 2026-09-06

_correction_2026_09_06: G0 calculator rewritten to v1: fixed-anchor normalization (IIA-safe), G0 split into G0-A heterogeneity and G0-B value, RAW_FINETUNE separated from REEMBED, support_label_count added. Prior min-max headroom numbers (.013/.500) withdrawn.

addendum_2026_09_06_episode_definition.why: MS-111-v2 showed zero selector headroom when episodes are tasks; MS-112 showed headroom .085 and three distinct winners when episodes include deployment conditions. Registered before any GEO-Bench outcome is read.
addendum_2026_09_06_episode_definition.episode: task x support_condition (K, stratified|random; support positive count recorded) x cache_contract (encoder family, size, release match) ; each (task, condition) is a deployment group; groups sharing data are reported as correlated, not independent
addendum_2026_09_06_episode_definition.first_selector: deterministic C0 + contract rules (support positives == 0 -> CACHED_HEAD; cache family/size below the registered cache-worthiness table -> RAW_FINETUNE or REEMBED; release mismatch -> BRIDGE then REEMBED; else HEAD_ADAPT); learned ranker only if the rule leaves regret > .02 on held-out groups

G0_recomputed_on_dev.deployment_grouping: G0-A pass (3 winners), G0-B .085 unlimited / 0 under no_raw_read
